label: SYNTHETIC_TEST_SCENARIOS_NOT_PROVIDER_FACTS
note: Every parameter below is an explicit hypothetical assumption for offline tests. None is a documented provider term, a realistic market observation, or a recommendation.

scenarios.label: Spread doubled
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: quoted bid/ask half-spread doubled at every bar.

scenarios.label: Extra slippage per side
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: one additional adverse pip of slippage per side.

scenarios.label: Commission tripled
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: commission rate multiplied by three.

scenarios.label: Adverse swap rates
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: both long and short swap rates scaled by three.

scenarios.label: Delayed confirming quotes
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: the last usable quote inside each bar is 45s older than recorded; bars whose last quote would then be older than 30s are refused.

scenarios.label: Periodically missing quotes
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: every fifth bar is absent for one pair; gaps are reported, never filled.

scenarios.label: Unavailable window
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: one declared clock window is unavailable for one pair (a weekend/holiday-shaped gap).

scenarios.label: Conversion-rate shock
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: one conversion leg moves by a declared factor.

scenarios.label: Shared-currency correlation stress
scenarios.description: Hypothetical: pairwise correlation for one pair set to a declared high value.
